messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] heads up on bug in saving init in output?
parts:
No, you’re right, the mcmc_writer doesn’t get triggered unless
a sample has been completed or a warmup iteration has been
completed and save_warmup=1. So you should never see the
initial values unless the first sample was rejected.
